records.issue_text: lib/tasks/disqus.thor:143 — Switching to `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], ...)` introduces an unrescued network fetch inside the per-thread import loop, so a single failing URL now raises and aborts the entire disqus import batch instead of just that thread
records.rationale: The diff shows the disqus import loop changed from local PostCreator.create to `post = TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, and `import_remote` performs `Readability::Document.new(open(url).read, ...)` with no rescue anywhere — neither in `TopicEmbed.import_remote` nor in the per-thread loop in disqus.thor. So a single unreachable/invalid URL will raise (OpenURI::HTTPError, SocketError, etc.) and abort the entire import batch, a behavior regression from the previous local creation. Mechanism is verifiable from the diff.
